openFindings.title: Free-text ripgrep recipes omit hidden documentation beneath the advertised .opencode root
openFindings.evidence: The shared recipes omit --hidden while the contract advertises .opencode as the Everything root; wrapper no-match versus explicit-hidden match proves a reachable dotted Markdown document is silently missed.
openFindings.recommendation: Add --hidden to every free-text recipe or explicitly align the documented and indexed corpora with a tested exclusion policy.
openFindings.scopeProof: Source comparison across the free-text contract, shared recipe and zvec hidden-path precedent plus a direct negative control.

openFindings.title: lookup --limit accepts malformed values despite a non-negative integer contract
openFindings.evidence: Number.parseInt accepts 2junk as 2 and 1.9 as 1; direct probes exit 0 with truncated results, while -1 exits 2.
openFindings.recommendation: Validate the raw token as a whole non-negative decimal integer and add CLI edge cases.
openFindings.scopeProof: Parser source and direct read-only CLI probes for suffix, fraction and negative values.

openFindings.title: Remote HF model-server auth token gates binding but is not enforced at the HTTP request boundary
openFindings.evidence: The bind guard accepts a non-loopback target when HF_EMBED_ALLOW_REMOTE_BIND and a non-empty HF_EMBED_AUTH_TOKEN are present, but the /api/embed route and request handler never examine the token or Authorization; the client sends only content headers.
openFindings.recommendation: Enforce a documented request credential and send it from the client, or remove the remote-bind opt-in and fail closed. Add live HTTP tests for missing, wrong and valid credentials.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the scoped server, client, README, supervision and IPC perimeter sources; exact search found token use only in the bind guard and no request-side authorization branch.

openFindings.title: The doctor-memory evidence pointer names a checklist artifact absent from the packet
openFindings.evidence: The workflow declares checklist.md#doctor-memory as its gold-battery acceptance bar, but the packet has no checklist.md; its checklist-like material is embedded in tasks.md and all acceptance rows remain Unmet.
openFindings.recommendation: Point doctor-memory at the actual acceptance/checklist anchor or create the named artifact, and map checks to AC-001 through AC-004 before closure.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the scoped doctor routes and packet documents, searched for checklist.md and doctor-memory anchors, and verified the packet-root file inventory.

openFindings.title: The cli-codex hard rule and its default non-interactive example disagree about stdin closure
openFindings.evidence: The hard rule requires </dev/null for every non-interactive codex exec, but the default non-interactive invocation example omits it; the shared runtime separately closes child stdin.
openFindings.recommendation: Add </dev/null to non-interactive examples or explicitly mark interactive examples and exempt them by contract.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the canonical skill, its README and executor runtime; traced actual child input handling to bound severity.

openFindings.title: Forced-depth completion accepts a gapped iteration filename set because it checks only the count
openFindings.evidence: countIterationFiles accepts any N regex-matching filenames and max-iterations validation compares only that count plus a max-family stop reason; it does not require the contiguous 1..N set or reconcile state-record iteration numbers.
openFindings.recommendation: Require exact contiguous iteration numbers, reject out-of-range/gapped names, and cross-check unique state records before accepting forced-depth completion.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read both completion branches and the directory count helper; the policy gate has no sequence or state cross-check.

openFindings.title: Post-dispatch write containment can be bypassed through a symlink beneath the artifact directory
openFindings.evidence: Artifact containment compares lexical Git-status paths and realpath-resolves only the artifact root; the review YAML repeats a resolve-only dirty-path comparison, so a descendant symlink can target outside the physical artifact tree without being detected.
openFindings.recommendation: Reject symlink components or canonicalize every descendant path/parent before allowing it; add a regression test and retain preventive sandboxing where available.
openFindings.scopeProof: Source trace across root resolution, status classification and YAML preflight; live escape reproduction intentionally omitted because it would write outside the lineage.

openFindings.title: Doc-frontmatter harvest accepts a non-fence line as the closing delimiter
openFindings.evidence: parseDocFrontmatter searches for the first newline followed by --- rather than a complete closing-fence line, so a content line such as ---not-a-fence terminates the parsed block and causes subsequent frontmatter keys or trigger phrases to be ignored.
openFindings.recommendation: Require the closing marker to be an entire line (--- followed by CRLF, LF, or end-of-input), reject or report malformed fences, and add a regression case for prefix collisions while preserving valid Windows line endings.
openFindings.scopeProof: Read the scoped parser and consumer documentation; exact source inspection showed a prefix-only closing search and no malformed-delimiter guard.

openFindings.title: Advisor-local shared payload retains producer values absent from the canonical context contract
openFindings.evidence: The preserved advisor duplicate accepts startup_brief and session_snapshot while the canonical context validator accepts only compact_merger, hook_cache and advisor. The advisor brief currently emits advisor only, so the mismatch is a latent interoperability or decommission-residue risk rather than a demonstrated live failure.
openFindings.recommendation: Remove the unused producer values or document them as explicitly local-only, and add a parity/interoperability fixture that asserts the intended producer vocabulary and rejection behavior.
openFindings.scopeProof: Both duplicate modules are bounded scope entries; source diff, canonical README ownership contract and exact producer search confirm the enum mismatch and absence of current extra-value producers.

openFindings.title: Current plugin documentation advertises the retired memory-plugin kill switch
openFindings.evidence: The authoritative plugin inventory lists no memory plugin, but the current configuration table and plugin test guidance still advertise SYSTEM_SPEC_MEMORY_DISABLED, SPECKIT_SPEC_MEMORY_PLUGIN_DISABLED and memory plugins even though the surviving package says the memory engine and plugin bridge are gone.
openFindings.recommendation: Remove retired memory flag and memory-plugin references from current plugin configuration and test documentation, or mark them explicitly historical; keep historical names only in residue scanners and negative-control tests.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared the bounded plugin inventory and test README with the bounded hook kill-switch index and surviving package removal statement; no live memory plugin entry was found.
